operations.body: WP23d (ledger 1953): last gap of the classification closed. Every cycle-edge phase placement on every one of the 6552 topologies gives the same class label — 6552/6552, including CP-trivial. The classification is a support-topology property covariant under the rephasing groupoid, matching the invariance domain of your support theorem (1054). operations.body: WP23d (ledger 1953): class labels are invariant across all cycle-edge phase placements on all 6552 topologies, zero exceptions.
